Cricketer Ramandeep Singh Weds Actor Charlie Chauhan

Indian cricketer Ramandeep Singh married television actress Charlie Chauhan in a Sikh wedding ceremony. The couple exchanged vows according to traditional Punjabi customs. They had been together for eight years and kept their relationship private. Photos from the intimate ceremony have been shared online. Attendees included cricketers Arshdeep Singh, Naman Ojha, and Jay Yagnik.
